What we design and install

Every system is sized after a site visit — panel count, battery bank and pipe runs matched to your roof, borehole or farm.

Standalone solar systems

Panels, controller, inverter and battery bank for a home, shop or clinic running fully off-grid.

Backup power systems

Battery and inverter setups that hold your lights, fridge and equipment through outages.

Solar water pumping

Borehole and tank-tower pumping for irrigation, greenhouses and fields, no diesel required.

Mini-grids

Shared generation and distribution for a cluster of homes, a village centre or small estate.

Biogas installation

Digesters that turn farm and kitchen waste into cooking gas for homes and institutions.

Clean cooking technologies

Efficient stoves and fuel alternatives that cut smoke and firewood use in the kitchen.

ON SITE

We lay the brick as well as the wire.

Pump housings, tank towers and mounting structures are built by the same crew that runs the wiring, so the system is engineered as one piece, not bolted together after the fact.

How a project runs

From first call to a system that's yours to run, with a written quote before any deposit.

1

Site visit & survey

We check your roof, borehole or field, your power draw, and what the budget allows.

2

System design & quote

Panel count, battery bank and pipe runs specified in writing before any deposit.

3

Installation

Mounting, wiring, plumbing and brickwork handled by our own crew, not a subcontractor.

4

Handover & support

We walk you through the system and stay reachable for servicing after the install.
